question: Which qualities of greatness, universal honor, and whiteness are attributed to the deity in obeisance?
premises: The deity is addressed as great-souled.
The deity is addressed as honored by all.
The deity is addressed as white.
inference: The deity is honored as magnanimous, universally revered, and pure.
plain_english: Obeisance to the great-souled one; obeisance to the one honored by all; obeisance to the white one.
